wife.meaning: The woman a man is married to.
wife.sentence: He went to the cinema with his wife.

window.meaning: Glass in a wall that lets light in.

windy.sentence: It's windy, hold on to your hat!

with.sentence: I went to the park with my dog.

without.sentence: I can't see without my glasses.

woman.sentence: The woman is reading a newspaper.

word.meaning: A group of letters that means something.

work.meaning: A job; or to do a job.
work.sentence: My mum goes to work by bus.

world.meaning: The Earth and everyone on it.
world.sentence: I want to travel around the world.

would.meaning: Used to ask politely or talk about wishes.

write.meaning: To make letters and words with a pen.
write.sentence: Write your name at the top.

year.sentence: I am ten years old this year.

yellow.meaning: The colour of the sun and lemons.

yesterday.sentence: I went to the cinema yesterday.
